name: interferon regulatory factor 8
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: IRF8 encodes interferon regulatory factor 8. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial diseases due to partial IRF8 deficiency (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 32B (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Pediatric-type follicular lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Illumina. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
